name: Andervenne (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Andervenne (a yellow sheaf between red hooks on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Andervenne; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Andervenne arms — sheaf and hooks on blue
